title: Colacasia: modeled ₹603/qtl left, Pampady → Thrippunithura
summary: March 2021: reported colacasia prices at Pampady and Thrippunithura imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 89% of 28 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹603 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 72 same-variety market pairs screened for colacasia in March 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Thrippunithura report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: March 2021
scenes.caption: Pampady (Kerala) and Thrippunithura (Kerala) both reported colacasia prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 28 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Pampady reported a median ₹2,700 per quintal. Thrippunithura reported a median ₹3,700 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹900/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹900 per quintal, and Thrippunithura was dearer on 93% of days.

scenes.headline: 64 km by road
scenes.caption: 64 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹14/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹555 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹370 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Thrippunithura report, the rule selects 23 of 28 modeled shipping days. 22 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹603 per quintal (₹411 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Colacasia route from Pampady to Thrippunithura was positive on 89% of matched days in March 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹60,300, or ₹41,100 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to colacasia
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹14/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Colacasia route from Pampady to Thrippunithura was positive on 89% of matched days in March 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹60,300, or ₹41,100 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
